AUTHOR: Catalán
TITLE: AI-powered underwater imaging reveals multiscale occurrence and volume-based abundance patterns in coastal fishes
REGION: Port d'Andratx harbour, Mallorca, Western Mediterranean
SPECIES: 16 species/genera (Diplodus sargus, D. vulgaris, Chromis chromis, Oblada melanura, Seriola dumerili, Sparus aurata, Coris julis, etc.) + generic fish
DATA: Own cabled camera stills 2016–2024 (442,000 images, 81,284 after filtering)
V_EV: Sec. 2.2.1: 'a deep-learning based automatic classifier removed images that were too dark (near night-time), severely blurred or turbid, or affected by lens fouling'
D_EV: no statement found (model 'trained on a curated and annotated dataset that included imagery from the study site'; split not described, refers to Catalán et al. 2023)
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: images 'collected from a fixed cabled underwater camera installed at 8 m depth' (single site; no external test reported)
C_EV: no statement found (Sec. 4.4 mentions 'fixed detection threshold' but no value reported)
E_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Presence-absence metrics were extracted from the entire frame, whereas volume-standardized abundance was computed within a predefined area of interest'
ARCH: YOLOv8-based detector/classifier (from Catalán et al. 2023) + DL image-quality filter + Retinex correction; GLMM hurdle models
METR: mAP@0.5, per-class AP; GLMM effects (occurrence, volume-standardised density, diel patterns, post-2021 shift)
NOTE: Application paper: detector developed in Catalán et al. 2023; training/test split and evaluation data provenance not described here (D NR, R_ALL NR). Poor-visibility images (dark, blurred, turbid) excluded by an automatic classifier without measuring turbidity -> P1 applied, V_ALL=N despite depth 8 m (V2), irradiance covariate (V3) and known camera-wreck distance (V4). E1=복수: occurrence, volume-standardised density, multi-year trend (post-2021 shift); no comparison with human or independent census. Detectability not modelled (E3=없음). Subsampling validation compares low vs high frequency AI counts only.
